title: Temple TX DREAM Home! 🏡 4 Bed | Pool | 2.7 Acres | 2 Large Storage Buildings |
description:
🏡 For Sale in Temple, Texas – 4 Bed | 4 Bath | 3,681 SqFt | 2.715 Acres | Pool | 2 Massive Barns | Open House July 19

✨ A Luxury Country Retreat with Endless Possibilities ✨

Welcome to your dream property in Temple, TX! This completely rebuilt custom home offers 4 bedrooms, 4 unique bathrooms, 3,681 square feet of beautifully designed living space — all set on 2.715 acres just minutes from town.

From the gourmet kitchen with hidden walk-in pantry, to the private home theater, game/craft room, and secret wardrobe-entry playroom, every detail in this home is designed to surprise, delight, and inspire. Step outside to your inground pool, huge driveway, extra concrete pad for RV/business use, and TWO massive barns (1600 SqFt white barn & 2400 SqFt brown barn).

📍 Temple, Texas – Central Texas living at its best
Perfect for: Luxury homebuyers, country living lovers, RV owners, small business owners, or anyone who needs space to live, work, and play.


📍 Address: 1656 W FM 93 Temple Tx
